findings.revision: Credit prior failure records and state the particular claim-level linkage evaluated here.

findings.claim: AgentMonopoly silently passes invalid outputs and has no retries

DECE v1 sections 3.2 and Appendix D.7

findings.claim: All economic propositions are decidable and every historical prefix is validated
findings.revision: Limit certificates to specified endpoints and intervention classes; limit validation to audited populations/prefixes; retain unresolved outcomes for incomplete search and social uncertainty.
